product_increments.title: Operational parallel delivery lanes

product_increments.next_action: Immediately after the delivery-control increment is accepted, activate two disjoint lanes: one for shared live leases plus trusted authority and metering adapters with runtime budget enforcement, and one for destination-aware accelerated CI. Prove duplicate-writer rejection, rejection of self-authored credit, pre-dispatch and runtime spend control, a fast leaf pipeline, and one-time aggregate proof.

routing.fallback: Continue with one explicitly human-directed source lane and focused local proof; do not claim multi-workstation source authority or accelerated remote CI.
